title: You don't need a telescope to photograph the Milky Way
alt: A star-filled night sky with the band of the Milky Way, above dark rocks and the corner of a building.

posts.facebook:
A camera on a tripod, left open long enough, records stars your eyes can barely make out. Bring the camera you already have, a tripod and a red head torch to a beginners' course or a dark-sky evening, and join a local astronomy society to find dark sites.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-astrophotography/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
